title: Current original bytes available for target-native regeneration
question: Do actual historical original registrations still resolve to exact local source bytes without retaining historical application readers?
method: Acquire exact historical database OID/system through a repeatable-read read-only transaction over original document metadata; hash existing local files with SHA256 and compare against recorded content hashes. No generated or protected answer bodies are read and no database mutation is performed.

outputs.role: Bounded read-only census source with exact acquired target refusal
Original registration metadata, file SHA256 and selected regeneration disposition

conclusion: Every acquired original registration resolves to an existing file with the exact recorded SHA256. The normal current original-registration and regeneration route has concrete source inputs; it has not yet been executed for these originals. Historical generated products and judgments have no established target-native correspondence. Database backup/restore, writer fencing, current application activation, regenerated results and development cutover are not established.
